name: hw-callout-circle
title: Scribble Callout Circle
description: A hand-drawn circle that draws around one phrase, with an optional scribble fill, a connector and a hand-written note below or beside it, sized to the measured phrase. Ships the hw-boil and hw-callout helpers for hosts that circle their own content.

controls.name: labelAt
controls.drives: connector start point, sweep direction, and label anchor pose (6 geometry params — promoted from the former raw build opt)

controls.name: strokeType
controls.drives: outline + connector stroke texture as authored constants per type (dash geometry, blur, seeded spray dots, mask-clone draw routing); the scribble fill stays plain — texture-on-texture reads as mud

controls.name: boil
controls.drives: boil amp/rot as authored pairs over the family-locked frameDrop 3; seed locked

variables.label: Note
variables.description: The hand-written note on the connector. Empty hides it.

variables.label: Note side
variables.description: Where the connector and the note go: left, right or below.

variables.label: Scribble
variables.description: Hatch fill inside the circle. Off by default: on a phrase it covers the letters.

variables.label: Stroke
variables.description: Texture of the circle and connector: plain, soft, sharp or spray.

variables.label: Boil
variables.description: Hand-drawn jitter: off, calm or lively.
